component.name: M3UTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetch" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetch() url = m.top.url if url = "" then return http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(url) http.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") http.InitClientCertificates() http.AddHeader("User-Agent", "Roku/1.0") port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") http.SetMessagePort(port) tmpFile = "cachefs:/mc_playlist.m3u" http.AsyncGetToFile(tmpFile) msg = Wait(120000, port) if msg = invalid m.top.error = "Download timeout" return end if code = msg.GetResponseCode() if code < 200 or code >= 300 m.top.error = "HTTP " + stri(code).trim() return end if content = ReadAsciiFile(tmpFile) if content = "" m.top.error = "Empty file" return end if rs = CreateObject("roString") rs.SetString(content) rawLines = rs.Tokenize(chr(10)) channels = [] groupsSeen = {} groups = [] maxCh = 4000 extinf = "" for each rawLine in rawLines if channels.count() < maxCh ln = rawLine if Right(ln, 1) = chr(13) then ln = Left(ln, Len(ln) - 1) ln = Trim(ln) if ln <> "" if Left(ln, 7) = "#EXTINF" extinf = ln else if Left(ln, 1) <> "#" and extinf <> "" ch = buildChannel(extinf, ln) if ch.name <> "" channels.push(ch) grp = ch.group if not groupsSeen.doesExist(grp) groupsSeen[grp] = true groups.push(grp) end if end if extinf = "" end if end if end if end for m.top.channelsJson = FormatJson(channels) m.top.groupsJson = FormatJson(groups) end sub
function buildChannel(extinf as String, url as String) as Object ch = {} ch.url = url grp = attrVal(extinf, "group-title") ch.logo = attrVal(extinf, "tvg-logo") name = lastCommaVal(extinf) if name = "" then name = "Unknown" ch.name = name if grp = "" first = UCase(Left(name, 1)) if first >= "A" and first <= "Z" grp = first else grp = "#" end if end if ch.group = grp return ch end function
function lastCommaVal(line as String) as String lastPos = 0 cur = Instr(1, line, ",") while cur > 0 lastPos = cur cur = Instr(cur + 1, line, ",") end while if lastPos = 0 then return "" val = Trim(Mid(line, lastPos + 1, Len(line) - lastPos)) if Left(val, 7) = "#EXTINF" then return "" return val end function
function attrVal(line as String, attr as String) as String needle = attr + "=" + chr(34) startPos = Instr(1, line, needle) if startPos = 0 then return "" valStart = startPos + Len(needle) valEnd = Instr(valStart, line, chr(34)) if valEnd = 0 then return "" return Mid(line, valStart, valEnd - valStart) end function
